t: How to Get the Best Cable Modem: Buy or Rent From Your ISP? | PCMag
s: July 14, 2022 - If you have cable internet, you probably rent your modem from your internet service provider for a monthly fee on top of your internet plan. It's usually somewhere between $5 and $10 a month, though most ISPs are less than up front about how much their services cost. Many providers allow you to buy your own modem and avoid those monthly rental fees.
